'''Gell Mattar''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] located on a [[Unidentified planet (Gell Mattar)|planet]] that was the site of a [[Campaign near Gell Mattar|battle]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[3666 BBY]].
